FUEL.note: The game piece: a 150.114 mm foam ball.

massKg.note: Game manual: FUEL weighs 0.448 to 0.500 lb

carpet.note: FUEL on the field carpet. Estimate: no FUEL force-deflection curve or friction measurement is available

bumper.note: FUEL on the bumper fabric. Estimate: no FUEL force-deflection curve or friction measurement is available

back plate.note: FUEL on the polycarbonate chute back plate. Estimate: no FUEL force-deflection curve or friction measurement is available

belt.note: FUEL on the gripping intake belt and top roller. Estimate: no FUEL force-deflection curve or friction measurement is available

NEO.note: Brushless motor class the project assumes: 5676 rpm free, 2.6 N m stall, 105 A stall at 12 V.

intake belt.note: One NEO drives the intake belt and, through a 2:1 pulley, the top roller.

intake squeeze.note: Slotted bearing blocks move the belt module toward or away from the bumper face.

intake belt speed.note: The intake belt's speed setpoint in software.

belt pulley height.note: Slotted bottom-pulley plates set how far below the squeeze line the belt meets the FUEL.

approach.note: Driven onto FUEL on the carpet, anywhere across the intake's width.

pickup.note: Side view at the front bumper: the FUEL climbs the bumper face and the back plate between the belt and the top roller and is thrown over the top of the back plate.

assumes.text: One FUEL enters at a time, on the lane centre.
The robot drives onto the FUEL at 0.5 m/s; the carpet moves under the FUEL at that speed.

control.note: Belt locked: nothing lifts the FUEL.
